claim: Five years of ageing, at least two in cask and three more in bottle, earn a red Rioja which designation?
because: The Consejo Regulador's classification defines red Gran Reserva as a 5-year minimum ageing, 2 of them in 225-litre oak barrels plus 2 years in bottle (60 months total, 24 in oak, 24 in bottle). The remaining year may be spent in either vessel, so the 'three more in bottle' stated in the stem is not the rule. The key (Gran Reserva) stays correct.
fix: Five years of ageing, at least two in cask and at least two in bottle, earn a red Rioja which designation?
